items.title_orig: Why does the other grunge bands sound far different than nirvana?
items.article_text: I like nirvana a lot, but then I listen to the other bands that are considered grunge like Pearl Jam, Alice In Chains, rage against the machine and most of their songs sound far different than how nirvana sounds, they sound more like psychedelic nu metal music, and I don’t mean their music isn’t great, it just confuses me that it sounds like far too different, I think soundgarden is the one that mostly sounds like nirvana, also Foo Fighters haves a style that also sounds enough different even if it’s Dave grohl the one that composed it, but sometimes it sounds similar, probably cause Dave haves a lot of influences from Kurt and that is kind of seen in his way to compose, but I sometimes feel frustrated that there’s no other bands that managed to get that surrealistic noisy music from nirva
